name: neno
description: NENO is a note-taking app that helps you manage your personal knowledge garden.

scripts.test: npm run unit-test && npm run test-intl
scripts.build: npx tsc && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && npx vite build
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run build:electron && npx electron tools/buildIcon.mjs && npx electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.lint: npx eslint src --report-unused-disable-directives && npx eslint electron --report-unused-disable-directives && npx eslint tests --report-unused-disable-directives
scripts.all-checks: npm run stylelint && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run integration-test && npm run build
scripts.all-checks-visual: npm run all-checks && npm run visual-regression-test
scripts.lint-fix: npx eslint src --report-unused-disable-directives --fix && npx eslint electron --report-unused-disable-directives --fix && npx eslint tests --report-unused-disable-directives --fix

author: Sebastian
